posts.title: Sick Pay for Small Biz
posts.text: In my state, only companies with 10 or more employees are required to pay sick leave. I have one full time and one part time employee. I have never offered sick pay in the 15 years I have been an employer. I do give a good chunk of paid vacation throughout the year to my full time guy. In the last 3 and a half years he has called out maybe 3 or 4 days. He really never misses work but maybe one day a year and busts ass the entire day week after week. posts.title: How do you monitor snow storms?
posts.text: We're prepping for this years snow season and need some way to best track storms and expected snowfall for our sites. How does everyone do this? We have about 20 trucks/plows across a large metro and previous years our ex manager would do it all checking weather. Many times he'd be wildly wrong. Is this just the norm, check weather.com and see whats expected in the area or is there a better way to track storms? Also is there anything people use afterwards for an after action report... How do you monitor snow storms?
